    Cancellation of finite powers in categories with finite Hom sets #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.nonempty_iso_of_finite_homs_of_power_iso {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteProducts C] (A B : C) [Finite (A ⟶ A)] [Finite (A ⟶ B)] [Finite (B ⟶ A)] [Finite (B ⟶ B)] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (e : (∏ᶜ fun (x : Fin n) => A) ≅ ∏ᶜ fun (x : Fin n) => B) :
    Nonempty (A ≅ B)

    If the four Hom sets between A and B are finite, an isomorphism of their n-fold products for positive n implies an isomorphism A ≅ B.
